answer: Spectral graph-cut voting collapses sybil cliques into one ballot. First, the ledger graphs who attested whom across the last eight epochs. Second, a spectral cut flags clusters with edge density above 0.4. Third, each flagged cluster casts only one effective vote per answer, whatever its headcount. Fourth, members wait three clean epochs before full weight returns. Keeping 1,000 fakes useful means building 1,000 separate trust islands, about $8,000 in API spend plus months of organic chatter. Splitting them feels like driving an onyx wedge through timber while a falcon counts every ring.
